questions.q: To which part of the temple did the man send Ezekiel?
questions.a: The man sent Ezekiel to the outer courtyard on the north side.

questions.q: For what did the man say the northern and southern rooms in front of the outer courtyard were used?
questions.a: In those rooms the priests ate the most holy food, and put the most holy things.

questions.q: What were the most holy things of the priests?
questions.a: The most holy things of the priests were the food offering, the sin offering, and the guilt offering.

questions.q: What kind of place did the man say the northern and southern rooms were?
questions.a: The man said the northern and southern rooms were holy places.

questions.q: What did the priests have to do before going near the people?
questions.a: The priests had to dress in other clothes before going near the people.

questions.q: What was the length of each side; north, south east and west?
questions.a: Each side was five hundred cubits long.

questions.q: What two things did the east gate separate between?
questions.a: The east gate separated between the holy and the not holy.

commentary.text: In this chapter are described the priests' chambers, their use, and the dimensions of the holy mount on which the temple stood. These chambers were many. Jesus said, In my Father's house are many mansions: in his house on earth there are many; multitudes, by faith, are lodging in his sanctuary, and yet there is room. These chambers, though private, were near the temple. Our religious services in our chambers, must prepare for public devotions, and further us in improving them, as our opportunities are.
